titolo: 50 Things From 1950s America That Quietly Disappeared

scene.testo: Milk once arrived at your door before sunrise.
In glass bottles. Left on the porch.
Now almost no one remembers it happened.
Gas station workers filled your tank for you,
washed your windshield, and checked your oil.
Families gathered around one television in the evening.
Teenagers watched movies from the front seat of a car.
Teachers taught students how to use a telephone.
But that's not the strangest part.
The biggest changes were the ones nobody noticed.
Stay with me, and you'll see exactly what vanished.
